latest.title: Kiro: What Every AWS Student Builder Should Know
latest.description: If you've spent any time in AI-assisted coding tools, you already know the usual pattern: you type a prompt, the model guesses at what you meant, and you spend the next hour fixing the gaps between what you wanted and what you got. Kiro, AWS's agentic IDE, is built around a different bet — that the real problem isn't the code generation, it's that most tools skip the planning step entirely.

latest.title: MLE, MAP, and Ridge Regression: What "Regularization" Actually Means Statistically
latest.description: Regularization is usually taught as "just add a penalty term to stop overfitting." That's true, but it hides a much more interesting story about two competing philosophies of statistics — frequentist and Bayesian — and how they lead to the same practical algorithm from completely different starting points.

trending.title: AWS Cost Optimization: 10 Practical Ways to Reduce Your Cloud Bill
trending.description: AWS makes it easy to scale infrastructure, but without regular cost monitoring, unused and over-provisioned resources can quickly increase your monthly bill. This article covers 10 practical AWS cost-optimization techniques, including rightsizing EC2 instances, identifying idle resources, optimizing storage, monitoring data transfer, and using AWS Cost Explorer and budgets effectively.
